capabilities: Render a vertical timeline from aion-timeline fenced blocks
Add and edit Ages, Years, Dates and Events through dialogs
Reorder entries by drag and drop with insertion previews
Sort Years and Dates using configured eras and month names
Search across all Ages of a Chronicle
disambiguation: Not a note archive or lore compendium; it renders a vertical timeline of Ages, Years, Dates and Events from Markdown headings.
extras: Installed manually rather than through the community plugin list; settings are stored per vault in data.json while Chronicle content and Age colours stay in Markdown. Mobile drag and drop is not an established workflow, and there is no in-plugin undo.
motivation: The author built it for worldbuilding and fictional histories, where a Year might be 804 BCE, Year of the Falling Star, or simply In the Beginning.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a long fictional chronology as a structured timeline with named years, custom eras and grouped events.
summary: Markdown-based vertical timeline that organizes a fictional history into Ages, Years, Dates and Events inside fenced blocks.
